description: This file defines a SwiftUI view for an onboarding wizard in an iOS app, managing the onboarding flow, including QR code scanning, manual setup, and connection status handling for a gateway device.

classes.name: OnboardingStep
classes.description: Enumerates the various steps of the onboarding process, each associated with a title and navigation logic.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardView
classes.description: Main SwiftUI view struct managing the entire onboarding flow, including QR code scanning, manual setup, and connection status handling.

methods.name: handleScannedLink
methods.description: Processes a scanned QR code link, updates setup fields accordingly, and initiates connection.

methods.name: openQRScannerFromOnboarding
methods.description: Prepares the state and presents the QR scanner for onboarding.

methods.name: resumeAfterPairingApproval
methods.description: Handles resuming connection after user approval for pairing.

methods.name: attemptAutomaticPairingResumeIfNeeded
methods.description: Automatically tries to resume pairing if needed when app becomes active.

methods.name: detectQRCode
methods.description: Detects a QR code message string from image Data.

methods.name: advanceFromIntro
methods.description: Transitions from the intro step to the welcome step.

methods.name: navigateBack
methods.description: Navigates back in the onboarding steps hierarchy.

methods.name: connectDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a discovered gateway asynchronously.

methods.name: selectMode
methods.description: Selects an onboarding connection mode and applies default settings.

methods.name: applyModeDefaults
methods.description: Applies default configurations based on the selected connection mode.

methods.name: gatewayHasResolvableHost
methods.description: Checks if a discovered gateway has a resolvable LAN or DNS host.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Initiates manual connection to a specified host and port asynchronously.

methods.name: retryLastAttempt
methods.description: Retries the last connection attempt, optionally silently.

methods.name: initializeState
methods.description: Initializes onboarding UI state from previously saved settings or defaults.

methods.name: scheduleDiscoveryRestart
methods.description: Schedules a discovery restart after a brief delay.

methods.name: saveGatewayCredentials
methods.description: Saves gateway token and password securely.

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Saves bootstrap token for gateway connection.
